name: The First Two-Control Cycle inside the Nonrealizable Bouquet
statement: After reflecting control $0$ and relabeling the four private coordinates, the 20-concept class $D_4$ is obtained from the 26-concept nonrealizable bouquet by deleting the two same-part private-pair fibers, six concepts in total.
proof: Direct comparison of the two fiber tables gives strict subfamily inclusion and exactly six deleted concepts.
comments: This is subfamily inclusion, not a pc-minor map. It transfers neither a maximum parent nor a minimum-cardinality claim.
